disclosed_matters.topic: Failure to Submit Annual CCADB Self-Assessment
disclosed_matters.summary: Izenpe failed to submit annual CCADB self-assessment.
Izenpe issued certificates with duplicate attributes in the Subject field.

disclosed_matters.topic: Not allowed Qualifier ID OID on Certificate Policies extension of Precertificates
disclosed_matters.summary: Izenpe used disallowed Qualifier ID OID in the Certificate Policies extension of precertificates.
Izenpe issued certificates containing incorrect Unicode characters in the Subject field.
Izenpe maintained an outdated Certification Practice Statement for the Izenpe Root CA.

disclosed_matters.topic: IssuingDistributionPoint extension in CRLs not marked as Critical
disclosed_matters.summary: Izenpe failed to mark the IssuingDistributionPoint extension in CRLs as critical.
